unknownsAndLimits: A unique GLB path/hash proves generated files are not byte duplicates; it does not prove real-world visual likeness.
The checked-in manifest has householdCount for only 2180 of 13607 assets, so household priority cannot classify the remaining residential assets without source joins.
Parks and heritage are not fully represented by one manifest category; this audit reports bridges and named cultural/landmark categories only.
No reliable geometry-level mesh signature was computed because that would require parsing every GLB; exact template reuse inside distinct files may remain undetected.
Generic procedural residential facades are explicitly estimates in the generator metadata and should not be described as individual real-world likenesses.

Survey apartments without reliable household counts remain pending household classification; known villa, multifamily, officetel and mixed-use categories enter remaining housing without inventing counts.
